title: the by-id read cache (`kind: cache`): hits, eviction on every write path, and scope isolation across tenants, roles, masks and policy rungs

authzGate.//: The by-id cache fixture: its isolation rungs are cross-tenant / cross-role / `own` statements in the e2e body, not refusal arms (see `sharedTenancyIdentity`).
